## Activity

During August 2024, Central Eye Clinic recorded 9 captures. This reflects the imaging activity reported for the month. The results provide a basis for monitoring local service delivery and identifying any operational issues that may affect image capture or subsequent grading.

## Image quality

Of the images captured, 2 were ungradable. The ungradable rate was 22.2%. This level should be reviewed alongside any equipment, positioning, patient preparation, or workflow issues that may have affected image quality. Recurring camera issues should be logged with the service desk so that they can be assessed and addressed through the appropriate support process.

## Grading

Grading identified 3 referable results. These outcomes should continue to be managed through the established referral pathway and recorded in line with service requirements. The median lag from image capture to grading was 1 day, indicating that grading was completed promptly during the reporting period. The site should continue to monitor turnaround and image quality together, as delays or repeated ungradable images may affect the efficiency of the service and the timely identification of patients requiring further assessment.
